name: settings
title: Settings page (tabs, form, server save)
description: views/account/settings.brain behind the scaffold's account guard: <Tabs> for Profile and Notifications, one form() with validation and an `f.ok` saved message, checkboxes bound to the same form, and a server function that validates again and saves. load() reads the current values for the signed-in user.
notes: saveSettings() is where persistence goes (database, provider API). Link /account/settings from the account page or nav.
